stories.title: Polícia Civil abre inquérito criminal para investigar queda de helicóptero que matou cantor Rick

en.title: Civil Police Opens Criminal Investigation into Helicopter Crash That Killed Singer Rick
en.summary: Police in São Joaquim have initiated a criminal investigation into a helicopter crash on Monday that killed five people, including singer Rick from the country music duo Rick & Renner.

stories.title: Copiloto que morreu em queda de helicóptero com Rick será velado na Igreja Matriz de Pongaí: 'Morreu fazendo o que amava', diz irmão

en.title: Copilot who died in helicopter crash with Rick to be held in wake at Pongaí Matrix Church: 'He died doing what he loved', says brother
en.summary: Leopoldo Barros Teixeira, a 34-year-old copilot who died in a helicopter crash while transporting singer Rick, will have his wake on Wednesday in Pongaí, São Paulo, with burial scheduled for Thursday.

stories.title: PT pede que STF investigue denúncias de interferência dos EUA nas eleições para favorecer Flávio

en.title: PT requests that Supreme Court investigate allegations of US interference in elections to favor Flávio
en.summary: The PT party has requested that Brazil's Supreme Court investigate claims of United States interference in elections aimed at benefiting Flávio.

stories.title: g1 promove debate entre candidatos ao Senado por São Paulo

en.title: g1 hosts debate between candidates for Senate in São Paulo
en.summary: The news outlet g1 is organizing a senatorial debate at 1 p.m. at TV Globo studios in São Paulo, with coverage on digital platforms. The debate is part of a series across eight states and the federal district.

stories.title: Guaíba: Defesa Civil de Porto Alegre alerta para risco de inundação

en.title: Guaíba: Porto Alegre Civil Defense alerts to flood risk
en.summary: Porto Alegre's Civil Defense issued a high-risk alert for elevation of the Guaíba River level, with potential flooding of the Arquipélago neighborhood and southern areas until Friday morning. The rise is caused by increased water flow from recent inland rainfall.

stories.title: OCDE vê alta dos rendimentos dos títulos como grande preocupação

en.title: OECD sees rise in bond yields as major concern
en.summary: The OECD expressed concern that rising yields on government bonds pose financial challenges for countries as debt servicing costs increase. The organization urged governments to control spending levels.

stories.title: CNJ cancela R$ 4,7 bilhões em precatórios ligados ao Master

en.title: CNJ cancels R$ 4.7 billion in court orders linked to Master
en.summary: Brazil's National Council of Justice cancelled court-ordered payments worth R$ 4.7 billion related to sugarcane companies that negotiated debts with Banco Master. The cancellation followed legal action by the government's attorney general regarding irregularities in federal court proceedings.

stories.title: Anvisa alerta para risco de contaminação em preparo caseiro de caneta emagrecedora ilegal

en.title: Anvisa alerts to contamination risk in illegal homemade weight-loss pen preparation
en.summary: Brazil's health surveillance agency warned that home preparation of weight-loss pen substances creates serious risks of contamination and infections for patients. The practice involves illegal manipulation of these medical products.

stories.title: Comunidade científica alerta para risco de interferência nas eleições

en.title: Scientific community alerts to risk of interference in elections
en.summary: Brazilian scientific academies expressed concern about possible foreign interference in the country's electoral process, particularly from the United States. They warned such interference could undermine national sovereignty, democratic institutions, and voters' free will.

stories.title: Candidatos a governador na Paraíba (PB): veja a lista das eleições 2026

en.title: Candidates for governor in Paraíba (PB): see the list for 2026 elections
en.summary: Paraíba has 6 registered gubernatorial candidates for the 2026 elections, with voting scheduled for October 4. If no candidate wins more than half the valid votes, the top two advance to a runoff on October 25.

stories.title: Paisagismo ganha espaço em projetos imobiliários

en.title: Landscaping gains space in real estate projects
en.summary: Landscaping is increasingly incorporated into real estate developments from early project stages, contributing to environmental performance, perceived value, and user experience beyond merely aesthetic purposes.

stories.title: Risco de restrição ao diesel nos EUA reacende temor de inflação no mercado

en.title: Risk of diesel restriction in the USA reignites inflation concerns in the market
en.summary: Speculation about potential U.S. diesel export restrictions has affected the domestic inflation market, prompting investors to adjust inflation risk premiums despite White House denials of such plans.

stories.title: Candidatos a governador em Goiás (GO): veja a lista atualizada das eleições 2026

en.title: Candidates for governor in Goiás (GO): see the updated list for 2026 elections
en.summary: Goiás has 6 registered gubernatorial candidates for the 2026 elections, with voting on October 4. A runoff between the top two candidates would occur on October 25 if no candidate wins a majority of valid votes.

stories.title: Transferência acima de US$ 10 mil por 'cripto' terá de ser comunicada ao Coaf

en.title: Cryptocurrency transfers above US$ 10,000 must be reported to Coaf
en.summary: Brazil's Central Bank announced new regulations requiring transfers to or from self-custody cryptocurrency wallets valued at US$ 10,000 or more to be reported to the Financial Activities Control Council. The measure aims to strengthen anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism financing rules, taking effect October 1, 2026.
